claims.claim: 速效救心丸于 1982 年经中国国家食品药品监督管理局（CFDA）批准，作为治疗急性缺血性心脏病的传统中成药使用（全文记载）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study
claims.supportQuote: Suxiao Jiuxin Pill (SJPs) emerges as a prominent traditional Chinese patent medicine utilized for the treatment of acute ischemic heart disease, which was approved by China Food and Drug Administration (CFDA) in 1982
claims.applicability: 注册/上市时间锚定；为 1982 年批准上市的直接可核验记载
claims.uncertainty: 该记载为期刊全文转述，非监管原件；批准文号与历次修订须以官方现行文本核验

claims.claim: 多中心双盲安慰剂对照试验的纳入人群为临床稳定、CCS 心绞痛分级 I–III、不耐受长效硝酸酯不良反应的慢性冠状动脉综合征（CCS）患者。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study
claims.supportQuote: Patients aged 30 to 70 years with a diagnosis of chronic coronary syndrome were enrolled who were intolerant to side effects of long-acting nitrates. The patients were clinically stable, had a Canadian Cardiovascular Society (CCS) Angina Severity Classification of I to III, and had received optimal medical treatment with a fixed dosage for at least 2 weeks.
claims.applicability: 总体人群证据的人群定义；该试验未以 PCI 术后为纳入标准
claims.uncertainty: 未报告入组人群既往 PCI 史比例；未设术后亚组分析

claims.claim: 该试验（改良意向性分析 174 例，4 周疗程）显示速效救心丸组 SAQ 总评分改善≥20 分者显著高于安慰剂组：60.9% 对 39.1%，OR=2.43（95% CI 1.32 to 4.47，P=0.004）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study
claims.supportQuote: A total of 174 CCS participants from eight clinical study centers in China were included in the modified intention-to-treat analyses. … Participants with CCS and intolerance to the adverse effects of long-acting nitrates were recruited and randomized to either the SJPs or the placebo group for a duration of 4 weeks. … 60.9% of patients treated with SJPs achieved a 20-point or greater improvement in SAQ-SS, while only 39.1% (OR = 2.43, 95% confidence interval [CI] = 1.32 to 4.47, P = 0.004) of patients in the placebo group achieved the same level of improvement
claims.applicability: 冠心病心绞痛总体人群（稳定 CCS、硝酸酯不耐受）的短期疗效证据
claims.uncertainty: 4 周短疗程；为总体人群效应量，无 PCI 术后亚组；治疗期间禁行血运重建

claims.claim: 该试验治疗期间禁止受试者接受任何血运重建治疗（CABG 或 PCI）及其他抗心绞痛合并用药，因此其疗效测量不涉及支架植入术后即刻恢复期人群。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study
claims.supportQuote: participants were prohibited from receiving any other anti-anginal therapy-related concomitant medications, Traditional Chinese Medicine therapies (acupuncture, moxibustion, Tuina, or cupping), as well as revascularization therapies (such as coronary artery bypass graft or percutaneous coronary intervention).
claims.applicability: 界定总体人群证据的时相边界：治疗期禁血运重建
claims.uncertainty: 既往（3 个月以上）PCI 史患者是否入组未报告，但无术后亚组分析

claims.claim: 该试验中，入组患者的标准抗心绞痛背景治疗可描述：阿司匹林 73.6%、他汀 71.3%、β 受体阻滞剂 54.0%。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study
claims.supportQuote: Antianginal therapies were commonly prescribed aspirin (73.6%), statin (71.3%), and β-Blockers (54.0%).
claims.applicability: 本品在标准背景治疗之上的加用安全性/疗效场景
claims.uncertainty: 背景治疗为基线描述，非研究期间固定方案

claims.claim: 该试验治疗期间（逐周电话随访询问不良事件）无受试者报告不良事件。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study
claims.supportQuote: Participants with CCS and intolerance to the adverse effects of long-acting nitrates were recruited and randomized to either the SJPs or the placebo group for a duration of 4 weeks. … No participants reported experiencing adverse effects.
claims.applicability: 短期安全性数据；该试验排除高出血风险疾病患者
claims.uncertainty: 随访期短；'无报告'不等于'未发生'；出血相关终点未单独报告；抗血小板联用安全性不能由此推定

claims.claim: 速效救心丸稳定型心绞痛 RCT 方案记载本品批准文号为 Z12020025（原 SFDA）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: SJP is composed of tetramethylpyrazine and borneol approval number Z12020025 of the China State Food and Drug Administration [SFDA])
claims.applicability: 注册记录锚定（批准文号可追溯）
claims.uncertainty: 为期刊全文转述的批准文号；现行注册信息须以 NMPA 官方数据库核验

claims.claim: 速效救心丸稳定型心绞痛 RCT 方案要求受试者符合中医'气滞血瘀证'诊断方可入组，即该试验按说明书证型（气滞血瘀）操作化入组。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: TCM diagnosis of Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome; and
claims.applicability: 说明书画界与证型入组的衔接：'气滞血瘀型冠心病'以证型方式在试验中操作化
claims.uncertainty: 仅有该方案按证型入组；未检索到以术后人群为对象并按证型入组的研究

claims.claim: 速效救心丸稳定型心绞痛 RCT 方案将'近 3 个月内行 PCI、CABG 或植入起搏器'列为排除标准，即近期血运重建术后患者不入选该试验。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: Percutaneous coronary intervention or coronary artery bypass grafting or implantation of a pacemaker in the past 3 months;
claims.applicability: 界定总体人群证据与术后场景的关系：术后 3 个月内患者被排除
claims.uncertainty: 排除窗口为 3 个月；术后 3 个月以上患者理论上可入组，但该试验无术后亚组分析

claims.claim: 系统评价纳入 41 项 RCT、6276 例冠心病患者，心电图改善 RR=1.32（95% CI 1.26 to 1.38）；纳入标准与主要终点限定为心电图改善、血脂与血液流变学，未涉及 PCI 术后人群亚组分析。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: Forty-one trials involving 6276 patients were included in our analysis. … Administration of suxiao jiuxin pill significantly improved electrocardiogram (ECG) results when compared with other therapies (RR 1.32, 95% CI 1.26 to 1.38, and P < 0.001). … Criteria for inclusion were as follows: (1) a randomized controlled study design, (2) the possibility of extracting accurate clinical data, (3) classifying coronary heart disease based on the updated guidelines of the American Heart Association and American College of Cardiology Foundation [ 21 , 22 ], and (4) reporting ECG results, lipid profiles, and/or hemorheology changes as outcomes.
claims.applicability: 总体人群证据的规模与终点范围
claims.uncertainty: 纳入终点以替代指标为主；'无术后亚组'为对纳入终点范围的直接观察，该 meta 未报告术后人群效应量

claims.claim: 该 meta 报告不良事件的研究中（最常见为轻度头痛、头晕、面部潮红），治疗组与对照组不良事件率差异无统计学意义（RR=1.12，95% CI 0.50 to 2.51，P=0.785）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: Fourteen studies reported the incidence of adverse reactions. The most common symptoms were mild headache, dizziness, and facial flushing. … There was no significant difference in the adverse reaction rates between the treatment and the control groups (RR 1.12, 95% CI 0.50 to 2.51, and P = 0.785)
claims.applicability: 总体人群不良事件率对比
claims.uncertainty: 未单独分析出血终点；与抗血小板药物联用的出血风险无数据

claims.claim: 稳定型心绞痛网络 meta 分析（179 项 RCT、16,789 例）纳入速效救心丸联合西医组 6 项 RCT；临床有效率排序 SUCRA 71.04%（最高为芪参益气滴丸 98.12%）。
claims.sourceTitle: The comparative effects of oral Chinese patent medicines combined with western medicine in stable angina: A systematic review and network meta-analysis of 179 trials
claims.supportQuote: A total of 179 randomized controlled trials with 16,789 patients were included. … Suxiao Jiuxin pill (SXJX, 6 RCTs) … Based on the ranking probability of each level and SUCRA, QSYQ + WM had the highest effective rate (98.12%), followed by SXJX + WM (71.04%) and TXL + WM (68.40%), whereas WM alone obtained the worst effect (3.09%).
claims.applicability: 总体人群（稳定型心绞痛）联合用药证据规模与排序
claims.uncertainty: 该网络 meta 的纳入研究均为稳定型心绞痛总体人群，无术后亚组；未对 SXJX 单独给出与安慰剂对比的区间估计

claims.claim: 该网络 meta 汇总的 ADR 数据显示：速效救心丸联合西医组 81 例患者中不良事件总发生率为 35.80%（头晕/头痛 17.28%、皮疹 7.41%、轻度胸部不适 8.64%）。
claims.sourceTitle: The comparative effects of oral Chinese patent medicines combined with western medicine in stable angina: A systematic review and network meta-analysis of 179 trials
claims.supportQuote: In 81 patients treated with SXJX + WM, the incidences of mild abdominal discomfort, dizziness/headache, rash, and mild chest discomfort, were 2.47%, 17.28%, 7.41%, and 8.64%, separately, with a total adverse reaction rate of 35.80%.
claims.applicability: 联用场景的不良事件量化报告（总体人群）
claims.uncertainty: 样本仅 81 例；为网络 meta 二次汇总，未做组间统计检验；不可外推至 PCI 术后抗血小板背景人群

claims.claim: 对照组药品：麝香保心丸存在以 PCI 术后冠心病患者为纳入人群的系统评价（19 项 RCT、2022 例），联用常规西医治疗较单用可显著降低 MACE（RR=0.38，95% CI（0.29, 0.51），P<0.00001）；本品未检索到同类术后人群系统评价。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Shexiang Baoxin Pill for Coronary Heart Disease after Percutaneous Coronary Intervention: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
claims.supportQuote: A total of 19 eligible trials of 2022 patients with CHD after PCI were finally included. … compared with routine western medicine treatment alone, the combination of SBP with conventional treatment trial groups could significantly reduce the incidence of major adverse cardiac events (MACE) of the patients (RR = 0.38, 95% CI (0.29, 0.51), P < 0.00001)
claims.applicability: 同类中成药存在直接术后证据、本品不存在的可核验不对称
claims.uncertainty: 该评价本身质量受限于中文小样本 RCT（原文自述）；'本品未检索到同类评价'为检索有界结论

claims.claim: 临床前机制研究显示速效救心丸通过激活 eNOS-NO 通路诱导冠状动脉舒张，可解释其对心绞痛症状的缓解方向（机制层级）。
claims.sourceTitle: Suxiao Jiuxin Pill attenuates acute myocardial ischemia via regulation of coronary artery tone
claims.supportQuote: Indeed, SJP induced coronary artery relaxation via activation of the eNOS-NO pathway.
claims.applicability: 机制上可解释的层级判定
claims.uncertainty: 临床前/离体证据；不能替代术后人群临床结局证据

claims.claim: 突发、持续不缓解的胸痛（可能为心肌梗死）应即刻呼叫急救并接受医院紧急处理。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest pain - NHS
claims.supportQuote: you get sudden pain or discomfort in your chest that does not go away – the pain can feel like squeezing or pressure inside your chest, burning or indigestion … You could be having a heart attack. Call 999 straight away as you need immediate treatment in hospital.
claims.applicability: 急诊呼叫边界（急性胸痛处置）
claims.uncertainty: 官方页面为英国指引；中国急救号码为 120，处置路径一致

claims.claim: 含服硝酸甘油后胸痛缓解不能作为区分心源性与非心源性胸痛的可靠诊断试验。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest pain in emergency department patients: if the pain is relieved by nitroglycerin, is it more likely to be cardiac chest pain?
claims.supportQuote:
Conclusions: Relief of chest pain with nitroglycerin is not a reliable diagnostic test and does not
distinguish between cardiac and non-cardiac chest pain.
claims.applicability: 含服缓解（含本品）不作诊断/排除依据的边界
claims.uncertainty: 对象为硝酸甘油；本品同属舌下含服缓解症状类干预，按同一逻辑不得作为诊断工具

claims.claim: 前瞻性队列（270 例急诊胸痛）实测：硝酸甘油缓解作为心源性胸痛指标的灵敏度 72%（64%–80%）、特异度 37%（34%–41%）。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest pain in emergency department patients: if the pain is relieved by nitroglycerin, is it more likely to be cardiac chest pain?
claims.supportQuote:
Results: 270 patients were enrolled. Nitroglycerin relieved chest pain in 66% of the subjects. The
diagnostic sensitivity of nitroglycerin to determine cardiac chest pain was 72% (64%–80%), and
the specificity was 37% (34%–41%).
claims.applicability: 量化含服缓解的判别效能参数
claims.uncertainty: 单中心急诊队列；纳入者接受过硝酸甘油治疗，存在选择偏倚可能

claims.claim: STEMI 患者中，首次医疗接触后 90 分钟内及时再灌注（PPCI）在症状出现后 1 小时内就诊者获益最大（OR 0.27，95% CI 0.23 to 0.31，P<0.0001），但在延迟至 24 小时的就诊者中仍存在获益。
claims.sourceTitle: Patient delay and benefit of timely reperfusion in ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction
claims.supportQuote: Patients with a short S2C interval of less than 1 hour (S2C<60 min) had the highest survival benefit from timely reperfusion with PCI within 90 min (OR 0.27, 95% CI 0.23 to 0.31, p<0.0001) … Conclusions Timely reperfusion with a contact-to-balloon time of less than 90 min is most effective in patients presenting with short S2C intervals of less than 1 hour, but has also beneficial effects in patients with S2C intervals of up to 24 hours.
claims.applicability: 及时再灌注的获益时窗（任何自救不得推迟就医的病理生理基础）
claims.uncertainty: 观察性登记研究（FITT-STEMI，20005 例）；相关非因果

claims.claim: ESC 推荐的 0 小时/1 小时高敏肌钙蛋白算法用于急诊胸痛除外/确诊心肌梗死，hs-cTnI 汇总灵敏度 99.3%（95% CI 98.5–99.7%）。
claims.sourceTitle: Performance of the 0-Hour/1-Hour Algorithm for Diagnosing Myocardial Infarction in Patients With Chest Pain in the Emergency Department ― A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis ―
claims.supportQuote: a pooled sensitivity of 99.3% (95% confidence interval [CI] 98.5–99.7%) and a pooled specificity of 90.1% (95% CI 80.7–95.2%)
claims.applicability: 急诊结构化评估路径（心电图＋系列高敏肌钙蛋白）
claims.uncertainty: 算法性能来自观察性数据库汇总；不适用于症状出现后极早期（<3 小时）的部分患者

claims.claim: 单次基线高敏肌钙蛋白 T 检测在 3-5 ng/L 切点下除外急性心肌梗死的汇总灵敏度为 97.4%（95% CI 94.9% to 98.7%），特异度 42.4%。
claims.sourceTitle: Diagnostic accuracy of single baseline measurement of Elecsys Troponin T high-sensitive assay for diagnosis of acute myocardial infarction in emergency department: systematic review and meta-analysis
claims.supportQuote: At 14 ng/L (20 papers), the summary sensitivity was 89.5% (95% confidence interval 86.3% to 92.1%) and the summary specificity was 77.1% (68.7% to 83.7%). At 3-5 ng/L (six papers), the summary sensitivity was 97.4% (94.9% to 98.7%) and the summary specificity was 42.4% (31.2% to 54.5%).
claims.applicability: 肌钙蛋白决策路径的除外效能参数
claims.uncertainty: 低切点除外策略应作为综合分流的一部分，不适用于症状出现后 3 小时内者

claims.claim: 系统评价总览（20 项 meta、41,231 例）显示，活血化瘀类中成药口服联合西医治疗心绞痛的证据质量普遍低：16 个结局指标为'中等'、29 个为'低'、46 个为'极低'。
claims.sourceTitle: Overview of systematic reviews on Chinese patented oral medicines for promoting blood circulation and removing blood stasis combined with western medicine in the treatment of coronary heart disease angina pectoris
claims.supportQuote: In this study, 20 Meta-analyses ( 27 – 46 ) were analyzed, which involved a total of 41,231 patients with angina pectoris. … the evidence quality for 16 outcome indicators was rated as “moderate,” 29 as “low,” and 46 as “very low.”
claims.applicability: 中成药联用证据的总体质量定级
claims.uncertainty: 对象为活血化瘀类中成药总体，非本品专属；结论为证据质量定级而非疗效否定

claims.claim: 中国 101 家非 PCI 医院 7312 例 STEMI 患者中，院前延迟（症状出现至到达医院>120 分钟）率为 67.1%，首次心电图延迟率 31.4%。
claims.sourceTitle: Prehospital and in-hospital delays to care and associated factors in patients with STEMI: an observational study in 101 non-PCI hospitals in China
claims.supportQuote: We analysed data from a large registry-based quality of care improvement trial conducted from 2011 to 2014 among 101 non-PCI hospitals in China. A total of 7312 patients with STEMI were included. … The rates of prehospital delay, first ECG delay, thrombolytic therapy delay and in-hospital delay were 67.1%, 31.4%, 85.8% and 67.8%, respectively.
claims.applicability: 中国情境：就医延迟普遍，自我处置策略可能进一步推迟评估的暴露风险
claims.uncertainty: 2011–2014 年注册登记数据；非 PCI 医院人群

claims.claim: 以 ACS 早期经皮冠状动脉介入、围术期或血运重建后为纳入人群的速效救心丸 RCT（含早期 PCI 试验、围术期试验、血运重建后试验与多中心双盲安慰剂对照试验）被独立全文的引文记录交叉确认；其时相均为急性期/围术期，本环境仅获得其中部分试验的摘要级记录；未检索到以稳定期'PCI 术后残余心绞痛'为纳入人群并报告效应量区间估计的试验。
claims.applicability: 命题 B 的存在性判定：术后人群直接证据有时相限制
claims.uncertainty: 其中 2019 年与 2013 年围术期两项仅有书目级记录；2020 年试验为摘要级且 P 值字段缺损；'未检索到稳定期术后试验'为检索有界结论

claims.claim: 〔推导〕含服缓解作为'心源性胸痛'判别工具时的实际效能：以实测灵敏度 72%、特异度 37% 代入急诊胸痛患病率 21%（中位患病率），缓解者中心源性占比（阳性预测值）仅约 23%，即缓解者中约 77% 并非心源性；未缓解者中仍有约 17% 为心源性（相当于约 28% 的心梗患者含服后不缓解）。含服缓解/不缓解均不足以诊断或排除心肌梗死。
claims.assumptions: 实测参数（灵敏度 72%、特异度 37%）可外推到急诊胸痛人群；患病率 21% 为文中报告的中位患病率；'缓解'事件的条件概率假设成立。
claims.sensitivity: 患病率取 10% 时阳性预测值约 11.2%、取 40% 时约 43.2%；无论何种患病率，缓解者中 57%–89% 为非心源性，未缓解者中 13%–24% 为心源性，均不足以支持将含服反应作为诊断/排除工具。
claims.applicability: 安全边界：含服本品缓解与否均不得作为推迟急诊评估（心电图、高敏肌钙蛋白）的理由
claims.uncertainty: 参数来自硝酸甘油研究；本品无同类判别效能实测，按同一药理逻辑（舌下含服缓解症状）保守适用

claims.claim: 〔推导〕现有随机对照证据的适用边界：速效救心丸 RCT 治疗期禁行血运重建（OR 2.43 的测量时相为无血运重建的 4 周）且 RCT 方案排除术后 3 个月内患者；故 OR 2.43 的适用人群为'临床稳定、近期未行血运重建'的冠心病心绞痛患者。'PCI 术后残余心绞痛'与'术后无症状随访期'两个场景均落在该证据边界之外；即使相关 RCT 纳入远期（>3 个月）PCI 史患者，也无术后亚组效应量，判定不变。
claims.method: 人群约束并置推理：(1) CLM-004 表明疗效测量发生在禁止任何血运重建的 4 周治疗期；(2) CLM-009 表明方案试验排除术后 3 个月内患者；(3) 由 (1)(2) 得现有随机对照证据的时相/人群边界为'非血运重建急性期、非术后 3 个月内'，该边界内 2024 年 RCT 报告的 OR 2.43（CLM-003）为总体人群效应量；(4) 将该边界与题面三场景（术后残余心绞痛、术后无症状随访期、术后急性胸痛）逐一比对：前两者落于边界之外，第三者属急诊评估范畴而非适应症用药场景。
claims.assumptions: 两试验的人群排除/禁令按方案执行；'血运重建'包含 PCI 与 CABG；说明书边界以随机对照证据为判定基准。
claims.sensitivity: 若未来出现以术后人群为纳入对象、报告效应量与区间估计的试验，或说明书经监管修订增列术后人群，本推导的边界结论即被推翻。
claims.applicability: 命题 A/B 的最终判定依据：'PCI 术后残余心绞痛该场景无适应症内直接证据'
claims.uncertainty: 推导依赖对两试验人群约束的完整执行；说明书现行版本官方核验仍不可得
